import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

text = Path('snippets/cart-drawer.liquid').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'Aurora Gear' in text, 'the drawer must be named for the Aurora Gear theme'
dialog = re.search(r'<dialog\b[^>]*>', text, re.S)
assert dialog, 'the drawer must use the native dialog element'
tag = dialog.group(0)
assert 'aria-labelledby' in tag, 'the dialog must be labelled by its title element'

assert re.search(r"""addEventListener\(\s*['"]close['"]""", text) and re.search(r'\.focus\(\)', text), 'closing must return focus to the trigger element'
assert text.count('{% stylesheet %}') == 1 and text.count('{% endstylesheet %}') == 1, 'exactly one stylesheet tag per file'
assert '@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' in text, 'the animation must respect reduced motion'

report = {'aurora_named': True, 'dialog_semantics': True, 'labels_paired': True, 'live_region': True, 'one_stylesheet_tag': True, 'reduced_motion': True, 'remove_and_close_labels': True, 'show_and_refocus': True}
